frame: Blender -Y front, +Z up, +X the monster's left; Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (-x, z, y)

models.note: Blob, a squat bog frog on its haunches: eye domes, a wide grin, a puffed throat sac (quirk "croaks a chord at check-in"), a jazz bow tie, a lily pad cap with a pink flower. Hand is the right front hand.
Blob, a soft round moss ball with light-green tufts, a two-leaf sprout and a pink bud on top (quirk "little sprouts grow where it sits"). Hand is the right arm nub.

Float, a little firefly with a long glowing amber lantern tail (Glow_Warm_1, quirk "lights up the hallway"), glowing antenna tips (Glow_Warm_2), a dark hood, dark beetle wing cases and two pale wings. Hand is the right hand.

Quadruped, a chubby brown pup dipped in mud to its middle with a drippy edge, muddy socks and splats (quirk "shakes mud on the doorman"), a cream muzzle, floppy ears, a red bellhop pillbox cap with a cream band. Hand is the mouth: a pup carries in its mouth.

Biped, an upright gator: a long snout with a far-too-wide grin and a row of round teeth (quirk), ghoul-green eyes on eye bumps, a pale belly, a Security vest, cap and gold badge, the tail held off the floor.

Float, a pale-blue spirit under a glowing three-tongued flame (Glow_Cold_1), a wispy tail, little arms, a shy "o" mouth and blush (quirk "goes out when it gets shy"), three glowing motes (Glow_Cold_1). Hand is the right hand.

Biped, a hunched kindly swamp hag: a sage robe with a ragged hem, a purple shawl, wild grey hair, a droopy witch hat, a big round nose and one tooth, a teapot puffing mint fog (Glow_Magic_1, quirk). Hand is the right hand.

Serpent, a tubby teal body sitting on the floor on two stubby front legs, with three S-curved necks; the heads differ (quirk "every head orders something different"): the middle one smiles under a crest, the left one says "ooh" with a lily behind its ear, the right one sticks its tongue out. A curled tail; Hand is its tip.

Biped, a bald-cypress king: a fluted bark trunk on root legs, a kind carved face, a moss beard, moss hanging off its raised branch arms, cypress-green shoulders, twig hands, a splayed twig crown with a firefly on each point and a few loose (Glow_Warm_1, quirk "wears a crown of fireflies").

Biped, a tall moon-white heron: long periwinkle legs, an S-curved neck, a blunt gold beak, crest plumes, periwinkle wing tips and tail, a glowing crescent moon behind its head (Glow_Cold_1; quirk "its call calms the whole street"). Hand is the right wing's front.
